definition: to arrive too late to get on the train
exampleSentence: Hurry up, or we will miss the train.
exampleTranslation: Nhanh lên, không thì chúng ta lỡ tàu đấy.

definition: to stay at the bus stop until the bus comes
exampleSentence: I wait for the bus every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng chờ xe buýt.

definition: to travel by bus
exampleSentence: I take the bus to work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi làm bằng xe buýt.

definition: to travel by train
exampleSentence: She takes the train to the city.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đi tàu vào thành phố.

definition: to travel by underground train
exampleSentence: We take the subway downtown.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi tàu điện ngầm vào trung tâm.

definition: to phone a taxi company to ask for a taxi
exampleSentence: Could you call a taxi for me?
exampleTranslation: Bạn gọi giúp tôi một chiếc taxi nhé?

definition: to wave your hand to stop a taxi on the street
exampleSentence: He hailed a cab outside the hotel.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy vẫy taxi trước cửa khách sạn.

definition: to pay for a ticket to travel
exampleSentence: I buy a ticket at the station.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua vé ở nhà ga.

definition: to let someone check your ticket
exampleSentence: Please show your ticket to the driver.
exampleTranslation: Xin hãy xuất trình vé cho tài xế.

definition: to pass your card through a machine to pay
exampleSentence: Swipe your card when you get on.
exampleTranslation: Hãy quẹt thẻ khi lên xe.

definition: to pay the money for a journey
exampleSentence: You pay the fare when you get on.
exampleTranslation: Bạn trả tiền vé khi lên xe.

definition: to get off one train and get on another
exampleSentence: You have to change trains at Central Station.
exampleTranslation: Bạn phải đổi tàu ở ga Trung tâm.

definition: to get off one bus and get on another
exampleSentence: I change buses on the way to school.
exampleTranslation: Trên đường đến trường tôi đổi xe buýt một lần.

definition: to stand in a line and wait
exampleSentence: People queue up for the bus.
exampleTranslation: Mọi người xếp hàng chờ xe buýt.

definition: to find a place to sit
exampleSentence: It is hard to find a seat in the rush hour.
exampleTranslation: Giờ cao điểm rất khó tìm chỗ ngồi.

definition: to let someone else sit in your place
exampleSentence: I gave up my seat to an old man.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nhường ghế cho một cụ già.

definition: to hold the bar on a bus or train so you do not fall
exampleSentence: Hold the handrail when the bus moves.
exampleTranslation: Hãy nắm tay vịn khi xe chạy.

definition: to press the bell to tell the driver you want to get off
exampleSentence: Ring the bell at the next stop.
exampleTranslation: Bấm chuông ở trạm kế tiếp nhé.

definition: to be unable to move because there are too many cars
exampleSentence: We got stuck in traffic for an hour.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi bị kẹt xe một tiếng đồng hồ.

definition: to arrive at your place of work
exampleSentence: I get to work at eight o'clock.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đến chỗ làm lúc tám giờ.

definition: to arrive at your house
exampleSentence: I get home at six.
exampleTranslation: Sáu giờ tôi về đến nhà.

definition: to arrive at work after the correct time
exampleSentence: I was late for work because of the rain.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi làm trễ vì trời mưa.

definition: to get somewhere at the right time
exampleSentence: The train arrived on time.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến tàu đến đúng giờ.

definition: to travel to work every day
exampleSentence: I commute to work by train.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi làm hằng ngày bằng tàu.

definition: to go to your job on foot
exampleSentence: I walk to work when the weather is good.
exampleTranslation: Khi trời đẹp tôi đi bộ đi làm.

definition: to go to school on foot
exampleSentence: The children walk to school together.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ cùng nhau đi bộ đến trường.

definition: to fasten your bike with a lock so no one takes it
exampleSentence: Always lock your bike.
exampleTranslation: Nhớ lúc nào cũng khóa xe đạp.

definition: to go up or down using the stairs
exampleSentence: I take the stairs instead of the lift.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi cầu thang bộ thay vì thang máy.

definition: to go from one side of the street to the other
exampleSentence: Look left and right before you cross the street.
exampleTranslation: Nhìn trái nhìn phải trước khi băng qua đường.

definition: to wait until the traffic light turns green
exampleSentence: Wait for the green light before you cross.
exampleTranslation: Chờ đèn xanh rồi hãy qua đường.
